title: festuca ovina subvar. scabrifolia
intro: Festuca ovina subvar. scabrifolia, commonly known as Rough Fescue, is a species of grass belonging to the Poaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina subvar. scabrifolia include soothing inflammation, calming coughs, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
